title: Cloudflare Access Issue
summary: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating an issue with Cloudflare Access. A recent Cloudflare Access release removed the sub claim from service token JWTs, which can cause authentication failures for applications that strictly validate token claims. The change has been reverted and the fix is rolling out globally.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
